overlap.title: Striking the rock is commanded in one scene and replaced by speaking in another
overlap.summary: Exodus commands striking; Numbers commands speaking but narrates two strikes and a rebuke.
overlap.reasoning: The actions and instructions belong to distinct scenes. An earlier command to strike is not an instruction for the later scene. The rebuke describes the failure more broadly than the physical action alone.
overlap.scope: The precise offense, relationship of the traditions, water source and historicity remain open; neither text supplies a verified hydrological explanation.
